description: This file contains the definition of abstract and concrete classes for splitting large protobuf messages into smaller parts and writing them to disk, specifically for use within the TensorFlow project. It includes a base abstract class Splitter, a composite splitter class ComposableSplitter, and related methods for chunking protobuf messages, handling file serialization, and managing message chunks.

classes.name: Splitter
classes.description: An abstract base class defining the interface for splitting large protobuf messages into smaller chunks and writing them to disk, with abstract methods version_def, split, and write.

classes.name: ComposableSplitter
classes.description: A concrete implementation of Splitter that supports message chunking, composition, and serialization to Riegeli files, with methods to build chunks, add chunks, fix chunk indices, and perform the split/write operations.

methods.name: versions_pb2.VersionDef version_def(self)
methods.description: Returns version information about the splitter and merge implementation as a VersionDef protobuf message.

methods.name: tuple[Sequence[Union[message.Message,bytes]],chunk_pb2.ChunkedMessage] split( self, )
methods.description: Splits the proto message into a sequence of chunks (messages or bytes) and a ChunkedMessage, handling chunk building if necessary.

methods.name: str write( self, file_prefix: str, writer_options: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Serializes the chunks to disk in either protobuf format or chunked format (using Riegeli), writing metadata at the end.

methods.name: None add_chunk( self, chunk: Union[message.Message, bytes], field_tags: util.FieldTypes, index=None, )
methods.description: Adds a new chunk (proto message or bytes) to the splitter, updating associated ChunkedMessage metadata.

methods.name: None build_chunks(self)
methods.description: Placeholder to generate chunks from the proto message; meant to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: None _fix_chunks(self)
methods.description: Fixes the chunk indices in the ChunkedMessage to ensure proper referencing after chunk reordering.
